messages:
harper (eng-ml): Quick summary from the aurora16b-2026-08 quant bring-up. Ran fp16 / int8 / int6 / int4 across a stratified sample (6k requests) + targeted evals. Need crisp routing recommendation for GTN and a conservative canary plan.
ida (ml): drop the numbers and any concentrated regressions please.
harper (eng-ml): scorecard below (smoke + eval slices):
```
model: aurora16b-2026-08
variants: fp16, int8, int6, int4
latency p50/p95 (ms): fp16 62/165, int8 66/180, int6 72/230, int4 92/420
tokens/sec: fp16 150, int8 175, int6 210, int4 260
unit token cost (est per 1k): fp16 $0.0028, int8 $0.0018, int6 $0.0011, int4 $0.00068
quality (multi-slice EM / rouge-L): fp16 92.6 / 40.1, int8 92.1 / 39.8, int6 91.2 / 39.0, int4 88.6 / 37.0
notes: int6 gives ~39% cost reduction vs int8; int4 bangs cost hard but shows large drop on instruction-following, code-gen, and safety-sensitive policy prompts. int6 has small mean delta but long-context tails degrade quality and latency.
```
noor (prod): which slices have the largest hits? any >2 EM?
harper (eng-ml): int4: code-gen multi-file + instruction chains ~3.8 EM drop; policy-check templates ~2.7 EM. int6: long-context legal templates (>2500 tokens) ~1.6 EM drop and p95 latency +120ms; document-edit/patching slice ~1.9 EM. Chat and short Q/A <0.4 EM. Rerank unaffected.
ida (ml): flagged: safety/policy regressions on int4 are non-negotiable for managed GTN. int4 must be opt-in gated.
vic (gtn): product needs: can we make a default mapping that's simple for new tenants? and what's the canary plan?
harper (eng-ml): my proposal: default mapping for new GTN tenants = int8 (standard). Expose per-route quality-tier with three choices: fidelity (fp16), standard (int8), eco (int6 opt-in). int4 = experimental, opt-in only with explicit warning and human review.
noor (prod): agree. add a subtle UX nudge: show estimated token-cost savings + sample diffs for the first 10 requests when customer toggles eco/experimental.
ida (ml): operational canary plan:
- Canary window: 72h at 20% traffic (stratified by slice)
- Probe sets: 250 chat prompts, 100 long-doc summaries, 80 code-gen tasks, 60 policy-template checks, cadence every 5m
- Replay sim: run hybrid routing sim (start int6 then switch to int8 after 512 tokens) on recent 100k requests to estimate quality and cost tradeoffs before canary
- Alert triggers: auto-fallback to int8/fp16 for route if probe EM delta >1.0 sustained 20m OR p95 latency increases >50% sustained 20m OR any safety probe failure (policy check mismatch)
- Human review: code-gen & policy samples triaged every 2h during first 24h
- Console: surface token-econ delta, per-probe time-series, and sample diffs in the experiment panel
- Rollback: automated rollback to 0% if any safety probe fails OR aggregate probe EM >1.5 for 30m
harper (eng-ml): engineering mitigations to test pre-canary: 1) KV-prefetch / prefix warmstart for long templates 2) hybrid routing by token index 3) micro-batching tweaks for int6 attention kernel to stabilize p95. We'll run those in replay infra.
ida (ml): I'll own probe sets, replay sim, and dashboard. plan to post 6h and 24h snapshots during canary.
vic (gtn): i'll draft onboarding copy: "Default: int8 standard. Offer eco (int6) as opt-in with per-route controls. Experimental int4 reserved for advanced customers and behind a clear warning." will include UX text for showing savings + sample diffs.
noor (prod): require a short customer-facing advisory that lists "not recommended for" tasks (code-gen, legal/safety, financial calculations). Also prepare support FAQ for opt-in customers.
probe-bot: canary-rule created: id=aura-2026-08-c1, start=2026-08-10T18:00:00Z, traffic=20%, fallback=int8/fp16, alert-channel=#eng-ml-ops
harper (eng-ml): decision: proceed with replay sim and engineering mitigations now; start canary only after we validate hybrid sim results. If sim shows >0.5 EM uplift for hybrid vs straight int6 on long docs, prefer hybrid for canary; otherwise run straight int6 opt-in.
ida (ml): noted. will post replay sim output in ~12h.
vic (gtn): thanks 44d will wait for sim output before publishing GTN defaults.
noor (prod): thanks team. please tag #support and #sales when we publish advisory.
harper (eng-ml): closing thread  will update with replay sim and mitigation test results.
